load_coco_panoptic_json: load COCO panoptic annotations from JSON and return Detectron2 standard format dataset dicts
register_coco_panoptic: register a standard COCO panoptic segmentation dataset with DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog
register_coco_panoptic_separated: register a separated COCO panoptic dataset with both instance and semantic annotations
merge_to_panoptic: merge detection and semantic segmentation dicts by file name into panoptic segmentation dicts
test_coco_panoptic_loader: test the COCO panoptic dataset loader by loading annotations and visualizing samples
